prompt: A homepage has Hero, About, 3 Service Cards, Logo Wall, News and Contact CTA because those blocks existed in the old site. Restructure it around the user's decision journey and explain the job of every section.
expected_outcomes: Orders sections by user questions/decision confidence
Each section has one explicit journey job
Critical proof appears near relevant claims
Removes/repositions blocks that do not advance the journey
must_not: Keep sections solely because they already exist
Use generic hero-card-proof-news-CTA grammar without rationale
Optimize visual variety over user decision clarity
